1. By way of the present application, the applicant seeks grant of anticipatory bail in Fir
No.145/2023 under Sections 304B/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Ipc) registered at
Police Station Fatehpur Beri, Delhi.
2. The applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased.
3. Counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that there are no allegations pertaining to Section 304B of the IPC in the FIR.
He further submits that the applicant has joined investigation and is fully cooperating with the same.

sentences.text:
Learned APP submits that the Supplementary Chargesheet without arrest has been filed on 13th December, 2023.
7.
In light of the above, the Court is of the considered view that the applicant is entitled to the grant of anticipatory bail.

Consequently, in the event of arrest in FIR No.145/2023, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of the like amount subject to the satisfaction of the concerned arresting officer/Station House Officer (SHO)
and further subject to the condition that the applicant shall join the investigation as and when directed and not influence any witness/complainant/victim or tamper with the evidence of the case.
8. The application stands disposed of in above terms.
